controls.label: Shape
controls.qualification: A sphere of the published radius; the neutral gray is a display convention, not a measured colour or brightness.
controls.notes: No image of the photosphere is cast here. The public CHARA/MIRC-X visibilities of April 2021 resolve the disc only about six beams across, and a reconstruction from them shows the same spots as one from a spotless disc sampled the same way (see the investigation ledger). Neutral gray marks an unresolved surface; the display axis is celestial north, a convention.
